description: If Mr. Anderson, aka Neo, has learned anything, it's that choice, while an illusion, is the only way out of -- or into -- the Matrix. Neo knows what he has to do, but what he doesn't yet know is that the Matrix is now stronger and far more dangerous.

Phoebe realizes that she must move on with her life and signs a lease for a new apartment; Paige considers moving in with Henry; Piper tries to maintain control after losing Leo.
